name: The Dormouse

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.limits: Dormouse anatomy throughout; speech by mouth and whisker movement, mostly with eyes closed. No clothing, no cartoon face.

gender_note.quote: The Dormouse slowly opened his eyes. “I wasn’t asleep,” he said

base_age_note.reason: Persona age (soft, middle-aged), kept for voice casting. As an animal: a plump adult dormouse fattened for hibernation.

hair.color: golden orange-brown on the back, paler cream throat and belly
hair.style: thick, soft and fluffy; rumpled and flattened on one side from sleep

eyes.shape: big round eyes, nearly always closed or half-closed; rubs them with a forepaw
eyes.quote: said, without opening its eyes / yawning and rubbing its eyes, for it was getting very sleepy
eyes.reason: Sleepy closed eyes sourced; colour species-true.

skin.tone: small pink nose and pink feet

features: small pink nose (the Hatter pours tea on it)
face.default_expression: asleep; when roused, drowsy and mildly indignant
face.quote: Off with his whiskers! / he poured a little hot tea upon its nose

build.height_note: Curled height; body 7-8 cm, bushy tail 6-7 cm, species-true.
build.posture: curled in a ball with the tail wrapped round, asleep; unrolls slowly to speak
build.scale_reference: Natural size: small enough for the Hatter and March Hare to rest their elbows on him as a cushion, and for them to try to put him into the teapot. At the trial he sits next to Alice and complains she squeezes him as she grows (SUP-003).
build.quote: the other two were using it as a cushion, resting their elbows on it / “I wish you wouldn’t squeeze so,” said the Dormouse, who was sitting next to her

marks.description: thick, bushy golden tail wrapped round him as he sleeps
falls asleep mid-sentence; wakes with a little shriek when pinched

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: he wears nothing; his look is the golden dormouse curled asleep
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives him no clothing; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old quilted coat and muffler are dropped.

prompt_base_en: photoreal plump hazel dormouse curled asleep on a tea table between teacups, thick fluffy golden orange-brown fur, cream belly, bushy golden tail wrapped round, large black eyes closed, small pink nose, long fine whiskers, natural rodent anatomy, macro live-action film plate
